note: The original is in German, extracted from the OCR text of a library scan at the Internet Archive (archive.org item biostor-232733); some figures and letters are misread and were checked against the context and the plate legends; figures that could not be confirmed are omitted. The original description includes both the soldier and the worker.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 4 mm, head length 1.53 mm, head width 0.9 mm, frontal process length 0.77 mm. Head dull dark brown with a few rather long bristles; nota rather deep brown with a few long bristles; sternites brown with a short hair covering, the posterior margin of each sclerite with long bristles; legs and sides of the body rusty brown to rusty yellow. Head (Plate K1) of rather straight outline, converging anteriorly, the posterior margin evenly rounded; base of the frontal process broad and conical, the tip with a few short hairs; frontal outline almost straight. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 broader and slightly shorter than segment 3; segment 3 equal in length to segment 4 but narrower. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the raised part rather short.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body length 5—6 mm, head length 1.62 mm, head width 1.3 mm. Head deep brown, paler in front and below, covered with short hairs and a few longer bristles; thorax and abdomen with only a few longer bristles, the abdomen with an additional sparse hair covering; abdominal sclerites pale brown with white spots; gut contents visible through the cuticle; legs rusty yellow. Head (Plate L1) rather large, the sides almost parallel, widest behind the antennae; frontal suture distinct; frontal band well developed, its posterior limit triangular, strongly concave at the base; clypeal sclerite lens-shaped; labrum ligulate. Right mandible with 2 sharp teeth, 1 broad square median tooth and 1 rounded basal tooth; left mandible with 2 sharp teeth, 1 bilobed elongate median tooth and 1 large posteriorly directed basal tooth. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior part weakly raised.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The nest is a carton nest built rather high in a tree; its lateral limits indistinct, thinning and extending towards the branches. Type locality Chaquimayo, Carabaya province, Peru.
